items.title: How SpaceX Stock Will Trade After Earnings.
items.summary: Early trading in SpaceX stock has been wild.  Coming into earnings, SpaceX stock was down 15% from its $135 IPO price and 43% from its record closing high of $201.80, reached on June 16.  Recent short selling will only add to the SpaceX post-earnings volatility.
